title: Baseline options: conflicts, missing paths and files
description: --create-baseline, --prune-baseline and --ignore-baseline select a mode, so any two together are a usage error (exit 2). --baseline-path only names the file. `configured` sets [baseline] path but has no file yet; `unconfigured` has no Scan.toml. A baseline is configured, never discovered: a scan-baseline.json that is not named by Scan.toml or --baseline-path changes nothing. Needs scan 0.15.0+.
upstream: BEP 1498: Finding fingerprints and baseline adoption (ballerina-spec/beps/tool-scan/1498_scan_baseline.md)

steps.name: Configured file missing
steps.note: Exit 1 (a configuration error, not a usage error): baseline scan-baseline.json set in Scan.toml does not exist.

steps.name: All three modes
steps.note: "--create-baseline, --prune-baseline and --ignore-baseline cannot be used together". Exit 2 with the usage hint.

steps.name: --baseline-path to a missing file
steps.note: Exit 2 (usage error, unlike the configured file): add --create-baseline to create it.

steps.name: --baseline-path to a folder
steps.note: Exit 2: baseline baseline-dir is a directory; set the path of a file.

steps.name: --ignore-baseline, configured file missing
steps.note: Exit 0: --ignore-baseline does not read or check the file.

steps.name: --platform-triggered, configured file missing
steps.note: The baseline is ignored for a platform-triggered scan, so the missing file is not an error.

steps.name: No baseline set: --create-baseline
steps.note: Exit 2: --create-baseline needs a baseline file; set 'path' in the [baseline] table of Scan.toml, or use --baseline-path=<path>.

steps.name: No baseline set: --ignore-baseline
steps.note: Exit 0: a mode that does not write needs no file.

steps.name: --create-baseline --baseline-path
steps.note: Creates scan-baseline.json, though Scan.toml does not exist.

steps.name: Plain scan next to an unconfigured scan-baseline.json
steps.note: Never discovered: the file is ignored, "2 issue(s)", and the gate counts both (exit 1).
